title: Neural Multimodal Topic Modeling: A Comprehensive Evaluation
subcategory: image-text neural topic models and image-based metrics
task: Systematic evaluation of topic models for documents with text and images
problem: Neural topic models handle text only; multimodal topic models were tested on few homogeneous datasets and lacked image-side metrics.
architecture: Multimodal-ZeroShotTM: ZeroShotTM extended so CLIP text and image embeddings feed the encoder and both BoW and image features are reconstructed. Multimodal-Contrast: M3L-Contrast without the second-language branch (contrastive mapping of text and images to a shared topic space). New metrics: Image Embedding-based Coherence (IEC) and Image Embedding-based Pairwise Similarity (IEPS).
key_results: Averaged over datasets, text coherence is similar for multimodal and text-only neural models (NPMI .03-.04, Cv .50-.52); LDA is lowest (NPMI -0.14).
Image coherence IEC .67 for Multimodal-Contrast vs .56 for Multimodal-ZeroShotTM; image diversity IEPS .41 vs .44.
Neither multimodal model wins on all dataset-metric combinations.
strengths: First broad benchmark (six diverse datasets) and first image-side coherence/diversity metrics, checked in a small user study.

limitations.text: English-only datasets; only coherence and diversity evaluated (no coverage or comprehensiveness); hyperparameter effects not explored.
